operations.name: bnpl
operations.reason: 9.3% of the movements: a BNPL purchase rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16 (E20 rests on the recorded fail-safe); its instalments need its agreements

operations.name: lending
operations.reason: 0.5% of the movements: a repayment needs a disbursed loan, and a loan rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16 (E20 rests on the recorded fail-safe)

operations.name: credit
operations.reason: loan credit decisions (R1): a decision reads the bureau and financial data, neither configurable on kind (the application refuses either until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved questions 13 and 14 are answered), so every decision there is the fail-safe path, waiting its 30-minute collection window and referring (INV-CRD-10), which is E20's subject and not the target's decision; a decision with data needs a simulated bureau on kind, an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16
